title: Your Code, But Funnier
description: Ever wish your `GitHub repository architecture` was less of a headache and more of a punchline? Well, here's `code-comic` to the rescue. No, seriously.
panel_text: Forget boring `README.md` files. This baby generates a `4-scene comic` from your code!
speech_bubble: Forget boring `README.md` files. This baby generates a `4-scene comic` from your code!

title: The Grand Entrance
description: Before the magic, you gotta get it running. Just a few commands to install dependencies, then hit the `cli.py` for action.
panel_text: First, `uv sync` or `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Then, watch `cli.py` kick things off!
speech_bubble: First, `uv sync` or `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Then, watch `cli.py` kick things off!

title: Brainstorming with Bots
description: The heavy lifting happens here. We `analyze_repository` to understand your project, then `ComicRenderer.render` kicks in for the visual flair.
panel_text: The `analyze_repo` tool crunches your code, then the `generate_comic` tool brings it to life.
speech_bubble: The `analyze_repo` tool crunches your code, then the `generate_comic` tool brings it to life.

title: Your Moment in the Spotlight
description: Ready to dive in? Check `docs/SETUP.md` for the basics. Or hit `tests` if you're feeling adventurous and want to break something.
panel_text: Play around with `.env.example`, read the `README.md`, or contribute to the `docs` folder!
speech_bubble: Play around with `.env.example`, read the `README.md`, or contribute to the `docs` folder!
